subject: EnterpriseBank — internal align before recontact
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-03-22T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: EnterpriseBank — internal align before recontact

Team — quick nudge. I did a discovery call with Sarah Grant / Enterprise Bank two weeks ago (notes in HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/deal/8891). I sent a follow-up on 2027-03-08 with a mutual action plan but haven't heard back. Before I bump them again, I want to align on the ask and make sure we are coordinated on technical commitments and next-step timing.

Key items from the call:
- They want a short POC around inference latency for high-volume batch scoring and an audit log retention plan (regulatory).
- Main blocker is security evidence (SOC2 + configuration details) and an estimate of unit economics for their expected 50M tokens/month.

Asks:
1) Dev — can you confirm whether the latency numbers we discussed (average 80–120ms p50 for 512 tokens on g4dn-class infra in Dedicated) are safe to quote, and whether we can commit to a short 2-week POC scope? Any specific constraints re: data residency or network topology?
2) Lauren — what sort of CS/Solutions time would we need to dedicate (hours/cost) for onboarding + compliance intake?
3) Jonas — any flexibility on an intro-level commercial sweetener (one month credit / discounted pilot) to unblock re-engagement?

I attached a draft re-engagement note (Marissa-draft-reengage.txt) and the risk matrix the prospect asked for. If you can reply quickly with feedback, I'll send the customer-facing bump (draft below finalizes to send once we have sign-off).

Thanks — Marissa
--
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai
From: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-03-22T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: EnterpriseBank — internal align before recontact

Thanks Marissa — quick technical notes:
- Latency: 80–120ms p50 for 512 tokens aligns with our Dedicated profile on g4dn/RTX6000-equivalent with batching disabled for low-latency paths. We can quote p50/p90 numbers: p50 ~100ms, p90 ~240ms for their expected load if we use a single-shard Dedicated pool.
- POC scope: 2-week limited POC is fine. Recommend: week 1 (ingest + baseline), week 2 (tuning + runbook). We'll need a sandbox GPU pool and a test dataset (sanitized) — I can own the infra setup but will need CS to manage dataset handoff.
- Security/data residency: if they require VPC peering + customer KMS, that pushes them toward Redwood Private; we can still do a Dedicated POC but need to confirm network requirements.

I'm free for a 30-min prep call today 2:30–3:00pm PT to align on demo script.

— Dev
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-03-22T11:00:00-07:00
Subject: Re: EnterpriseBank — internal align before recontact

Adding CS context:
- Onboarding effort: estimated 40–60 engineer-hours for a standard Dedicated POC (includes dataset review, runbook, and 2 support handoffs). If they need Private/VPC + KMS, estimate 80–120 hours.
- Compliance evidence: we can provide SOC2 summary + audit logs export template (attached: EnterpriseBank-RiskMatrix.xlsx). For anything beyond our standard exports (longer retention windows), that will require an add-on.
- Support model: I recommend offering a 4-week SOC2 evidence review window and a named CS lead during the POC. We should include a proposal for a paid pilot with clear success criteria.

I can be on the call if we run a technical walkthrough.

— Lauren
Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-03-22T11:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: EnterpriseBank — internal align before recontact

Thumbs up from me. Marissa — you have authority to offer a one-month credit for pilot consumption (cap $20k) to get them back on the table, contingent on a signed mutual action plan and a confirmed POC schedule. Make sure the mutual action plan includes the success criteria Dev and Lauren outlined.

If they push for Private immediately, loop in Legal — but don't offer entitlements beyond the credit without approval.

— Jonas
Director, Sales, Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-03-22T12:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: EnterpriseBank — internal align before recontact

Thanks all — summary and next steps:
- Tech: Dev confirms latency guidance (p50 ~100ms / p90 ~240ms). Dev will run infra prep for a 2-week POC (week-of 4/4).
- CS: Lauren will own named CS lead and SOC2 evidence review; estimate 40–60 hrs for Dedicated POC.
- Commercial: Jonas approves one-month credit up to $20k contingent on MAP.

I'll send the re-engagement note to Sarah + Mike after 12:30pm PT with the proposed pilot outline and a proposed call for week-of 4/4. Draft (sending to Sarah/Mike when you sign off):

--- DRAFT CUSTOMER BUMP ---
Subject: Quick follow-up + proposed 2-week POC (EnterpriseBank + Redwood)

Hi Sarah / Mike —

Hope you're well. Following up on my note from earlier — we'd love to propose a short 2-week pilot to validate latency and audit-log exports for your use case. Proposed plan:
- Week 1: baseline tests + dataset ingest
- Week 2: tuning + runbook + evidence handoff

We can provide a named CS lead, SOC2 summary, and a one-month credit toward pilot consumption (Jonas approved, up to $20k). Are you available for a 30-min sync the week of Apr 4 to align on logistics?

If there are any requirements around VPC/KMS, let me know and we can scope Private options, but we think Dedicated will get them quick results.

Thanks — looking forward to your thoughts.

Marissa
--- END DRAFT ---

Please reply with any edits by 12:20pm PT; if no objections I'll send at 12:30pm.

Attachments: Marissa-draft-reengage.txt, EnterpriseBank-RiskMatrix.xlsx
